_note: Floor 5 of the Drambus Stack, and one sitting. `outside` is what makes it one: beating the boss puts you back in the field and a save taken inside reopens there too, so a floor is a thing you go in and finish or do not. Ten by ten, one thing at the end of it, and the next entry is a different map because the tower is a floor shorter. Which floor the door opens onto is derived from what has been answered rather than from a counter — the boss tiles are the record, and the order they come down in is the whole of the condition.

places.name: what is standing on floor 5
prose: The floor gives under the last of it and keeps giving, and the whole storey comes down about four feet and stops, and the noise it makes is not a crash. It is a settle.
You are outside. You did not walk out. There are four floors left and the door is where the door was, an inch lower.
